<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="dc-v9-visual">/* Old Home visual parity vs Railway v9 */
:root{--bg:#080F25;--bg2:#0D1530;--bg3:#111B3A;--purple:#6C72FF;--purple-hover:#5A5FE6;--pl:#8B90FF;--gold:#D78E2C;--cream:#FAF3E1;--white:#fff;--mu:rgba(255,255,255,.38);--se:rgba(255,255,255,.62);--bo:rgba(255,255,255,.07);--bp:rgba(108,114,255,.28);--font:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;--serif:'Lora',serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.dc-page{font-family:var(--font);background:var(--bg);color:#fff;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;position:relative}
.dc-si{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1}
.dc-section,.dc-cta{position:relative;padding:88px 48px;overflow:hidden}
.dc-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:86vh;padding:120px 48px 80px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.dc-dg{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(108,114,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(-45deg,rgba(108,114,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:56px 56px}
.dc-bg-blob{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;user-select:none;width:min(640px,88vw);height:auto;opacity:.75;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.dc-hero-mesh{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;display:block;opacity:.9}
.dc-hero-grid{position:relative;z-index:2;width:100%;max-width:min(900px,94vw);margin:0 auto;text-align:center}
.dc-ey{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--pl);margin-bottom:14px;text-transform:uppercase}
.dc-h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.5vw,44px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:14px}
.dc-lead{font-size:17px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.7;max-width:540px;margin-bottom:40px}
.dc-dvb{width:44px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),transparent);margin-bottom:28px}
#problem,#how,#faq{background:var(--bg2);border-top:1px solid var(--bo);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}
#proofbar,.dc-proofbar{background:var(--bg3);border-top:1px solid var(--bo);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}
#cta.dc-cta,.dc-cta{background:var(--bg);border-top:1px solid var(--bo);text-align:center;padding:96px 48px}
.dc-nav{background:rgba(8,15,37,.88);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}
.dc-nav.dc-nav-sc{background:rgba(8,15,37,.98)}
.dc-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(108,114,255,.1);border:1px solid var(--bp);padding:6px 16px;border-radius:100px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pl);margin-bottom:32px}
.dc-puls{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);animation:dc-pulse 3s infinite}
@keyframes dc-pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
.dc-h1wrap{display:inline-flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.32em;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;--hr-lh:clamp(32px,4vw,56px);--hr-slots:5}
.dc-hstatic{font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap}
.dc-hrwrap{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;height:calc(var(--hr-lh)*var(--hr-slots));width:var(--hr-w,auto);overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;contain:strict;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0%,#000 12%,#000 88%,transparent 100%)}
.dc-hrinner{display:flex;flex-direction:column;will-change:transform;backface-visibility:hidden}
.dc-hrword{display:flex;align-items:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,48px);line-height:1.08;height:var(--hr-lh);color:var(--pl);white-space:nowrap;opacity:.08;transition:opacity .45s ease,color .45s ease}
.dc-hrword.near{opacity:.28}.dc-hrword.far{opacity:.14}
.dc-hrword.on{font-family:var(--font);font-style:normal;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--gold);opacity:1}
.dc-hsub{font-size:17px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.7;max-width:640px;margin:24px auto 28px}
.dc-ctas{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px}
.dc-bp2{font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;background:var(--purple);border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.dc-bp2:hover{background:var(--purple-hover);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(108,114,255,.3)}
.dc-bs2{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--bp);cursor:pointer;padding:13px 26px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.dc-bs2:hover{border-color:var(--purple);background:rgba(108,114,255,.12)}
.dc-pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);align-items:stretch;background:var(--bo);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;gap:1px;margin-top:48px}
.dc-pcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:100%;background:var(--bg2);padding:34px 30px}
.dc-pwho{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--pl);margin-bottom:14px}
.dc-ph{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:14px}
.dc-pb{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.65;flex:1}
.dc-pr{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--cream);margin-top:18px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--bo);line-height:1.55}
.dc-stage-tabs{display:flex;gap:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:8px 0 4px;position:relative}
.dc-stage-tabs::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:35px;left:8%;right:8%;height:1px;background:var(--bo);z-index:0}
.dc-stage-tab{background:none;border:none;color:rgba(139,144,255,.55);cursor:pointer;padding:0 10px 6px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;flex:1 1 0;min-width:96px;text-align:center;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.dc-stage-tab-on{color:var(--pl)}
.dc-fbt-ico{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(108,114,255,.22);background:var(--bg2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:rgba(139,144,255,.42);transition:all .3s var(--ease)}
.dc-fbt-ico svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.dc-stage-tab-on .dc-fbt-ico{border-color:var(--purple);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(108,114,255,.22),rgba(108,114,255,.08));color:var(--pl);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(108,114,255,.12),0 8px 28px rgba(108,114,255,.18)}
.dc-fbprogress{height:2px;background:var(--bo);border-radius:2px;margin:6px 8.33% 12px;overflow:hidden}
.dc-fbprogress-fill{height:100%;width:16.66%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold),var(--purple));border-radius:2px;transition:width .5s var(--ease)}
.dc-fbtour-pause{position:absolute;right:0;top:2px;background:none;border:none;color:var(--mu);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 0;font-family:inherit}
.dc-stage-panel{display:none;padding:28px;border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px;background:var(--bg2);margin-top:8px}
.dc-stage-panel-on{display:block}
.dc-fbp2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start}
.dc-shot{width:100%;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--bo);display:block}
.dc-fbck{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--se);padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}
.dc-fbi-d{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.28);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;color:#22c55e;flex-shrink:0}
.dc-fb-outcome{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--bo);font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:rgba(108,114,255,.9)}
.dc-dr-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:center;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--bp);border-radius:12px;padding:22px 20px;margin-top:16px}
.dc-dr-ring{position:relative;width:112px;height:112px}
.dc-dr-ring svg{width:112px;height:112px;transform:rotate(-90deg)}
.dc-dr-bg{fill:none;stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.08);stroke-width:10}
.dc-dr-fill{fill:none;stroke:url(#dc-rg);stroke-width:10;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:364;stroke-dashoffset:364;transition:stroke-dashoffset 1.4s var(--ease)}
.dc-dr-center{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.dc-dr-val{font-size:24px;font-weight:800;color:#fff}
.dc-dr-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--mu);letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}
.dc-drm{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:8px;padding:11px 12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.dc-drm-l{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:7px}
.dc-drm-track{height:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:100px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px}
.dc-drm-bar{height:100%;width:0%;border-radius:100px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--purple),var(--pl));transition:width 2s var(--ease)}
.dc-drm-v{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff}
.dc-aud-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0;background:var(--bo);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.dc-aud-tab{background:var(--bg3);border:none;border-right:1px solid var(--bo);color:inherit;text-align:left;padding:22px 20px;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;position:relative}
.dc-aud-tab:last-child{border-right:none}
.dc-aud-tab-on{background:var(--bg2)}
.dc-aud-tab-on::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:var(--purple)}
.dc-aud-ico{width:24px;height:24px;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.dc-aud-ico--o{color:var(--gold)}.dc-aud-ico--b{color:var(--pl)}.dc-aud-ico--p{color:rgba(250,243,225,.55)}
.dc-aud-panel{display:none;padding:32px 28px;border:1px solid var(--bo);border-top:none;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;background:var(--bg2)}
.dc-aud-panel-on{display:block}
.dc-bi{padding:18px;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.dc-bi-t{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px}
.dc-bi-d{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.6}
.dc-betabox{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(108,114,255,.1),rgba(215,142,44,.06));border:1px solid var(--bp);border-radius:12px;padding:28px}
.dc-founder{display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:flex-start}
.dc-founder-img{width:80px;height:80px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 18%;border:1px solid var(--bp);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.dc-wq{max-width:42em;margin-bottom:12px}
.dc-wq p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.75vw,18px);color:rgba(250,243,225,.82);line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 12px}
.dc-wa{font-size:14px;color:var(--mu)}
.dc-faq-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(280px,.8fr);gap:40px;align-items:start;margin-top:40px}
.dc-faq-list{border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:0}
.dc-faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--bo)}
.dc-faq-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.dc-faq-q{width:100%;background:var(--bg2);border:none;padding:20px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;color:#fff;font:inherit}
.dc-faq-item.open .dc-faq-q{background:var(--bg3)}
.dc-faq-q-t,.dc-faq-q{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.dc-faq-ico{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--bp);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--pl)}
.dc-faq-a{display:none;background:var(--bg2)}
.dc-faq-a-open{display:block}
.dc-faq-a p,.dc-faq-a{font-size:15px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.75;padding:0 24px 20px}
.dc-faq-side{position:sticky;top:88px}
.dc-faq-side-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:14px}
.dc-wcards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
.dc-wc{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--bo);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 16px;transition:border-color .3s}
.dc-wc:hover{border-color:var(--bp)}
.dc-wcl{font-size:13px;color:var(--se);line-height:1.6}
.dc-wcl strong{display:block;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:5px}
.dc-vs-wrap{margin-top:48px}
.dc-footer,.dc-ft{border-top:1px solid var(--bo);padding:48px;background:var(--bg)}
.dc-ftop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:32px}
.dc-mnav{display:none}.dc-mnav-open{display:block}
.dc-overview{display:none}.dc-overview-open{display:block}
.dc-proof-extra{display:contents}
@media(max-width:960px){
  .dc-section,.dc-cta,.dc-hero,.dc-footer,.dc-ft{padding-left:20px;padding-right:20px}
  .dc-h1wrap{flex-direction:column;overflow:visible;width:100%}
  .dc-hstatic,.dc-hrword{font-size:clamp(22px,6.2vw,34px)}
  .dc-pgrid,.dc-aud-tabs,.dc-fbp2,.dc-faq-layout,.dc-ftop,.dc-dr-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .dc-faq-side{position:static}
  .dc-stage-tabs::before{display:none}
}</style>

<script>
(function(){
  function ready(fn){if(document.readyState!=='loading')fn();else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',fn);}
  ready(function(){
    // Stage icons
    var ICONS=[
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polygon points="16.24 7.76 14.12 14.12 7.76 16.24 9.88 9.88" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 6v6l3.5 2"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/></svg>',
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="6"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="2"/></svg>',
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 21l-7-5-7 5V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>',
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="4" y="4" width="6" height="16" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="8" width="6" height="12" rx="1"/><path d="M2 20h20"/></svg>',
      '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z"/><polyline points="14 2 14 8 20 8"/><path d="M12 12v6"/><path d="M9 15h6"/></svg>'
    ];
    document.querySelectorAll('.dc-stage-tab').forEach(function(tab,i){
      if(tab.querySelector('.dc-fbt-ico'))return;
      var ico=document.createElement('span');
      ico.className='dc-fbt-ico';
      ico.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      ico.innerHTML=ICONS[i]||ICONS[0];
      tab.insertBefore(ico,tab.firstChild);
    });

    // Audience icons
    var AUD=[
      '<svg class="dc-aud-ico dc-aud-ico--o" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M16 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="9" cy="7" r="4"/><path d="M22 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-3-3.87"/><path d="M16 3.13a4 4 0 0 1 0 7.75"/></svg>',
      '<svg class="dc-aud-ico dc-aud-ico--b" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M12 8v8"/><path d="M8 12h8"/></svg>',
      '<svg class="dc-aud-ico dc-aud-ico--p" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 21h18"/><path d="M5 21V7l7-4 7 4v14"/><path d="M9 21v-6h6v6"/></svg>'
    ];
    document.querySelectorAll('.dc-aud-tab').forEach(function(tab,i){
      if(tab.querySelector('.dc-aud-ico'))return;
      var wrap=document.createElement('span');
      wrap.innerHTML=AUD[i]||AUD[0];
      tab.insertBefore(wrap.firstChild,tab.firstChild);
    });

    // FAQ plus icons
    document.querySelectorAll('.dc-faq-q').forEach(function(q){
      if(q.querySelector('.dc-faq-ico'))return;
      var ico=document.createElement('span');
      ico.className='dc-faq-ico';
      ico.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      ico.innerHTML='<svg viewBox="0 0 10 10" width="10" height="10"><line x1="5" y1="1" x2="5" y2="9" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/><line x1="1" y1="5" x2="9" y2="5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg>';
      q.appendChild(ico);
    });

    // Dot grids on key sections if missing
    ['#how','#faq','#audiences','#why'].forEach(function(sel){
      var el=document.querySelector(sel);
      if(!el||el.querySelector('.dc-dg'))return;
      var dg=document.createElement('div');
      dg.className='dc-dg';
      dg.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      el.insertBefore(dg,el.firstChild);
    });

    // Hero mesh animation
    (function(){
      var hero=document.getElementById('hero');
      var canvas=document.getElementById('hero-mesh');
      if(!hero||!canvas)return;
      var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
      if(!ctx)return;
      var pts=[], raf=0, reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      function resize(){
        var r=hero.getBoundingClientRect();
        var dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
        var w=Math.max(1,Math.floor(r.width)), h=Math.max(1,Math.floor(r.height));
        canvas.width=Math.round(w*dpr); canvas.height=Math.round(h*dpr);
        canvas.style.width=w+'px'; canvas.style.height=h+'px';
        ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
        pts=[];
        var n=Math.min(70,Math.floor((w*h)/18000));
        for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
          pts.push({x:Math.random()*w,y:Math.random()*h,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.25,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.25});
        }
      }
      function draw(){
        var w=canvas.clientWidth, h=canvas.clientHeight;
        ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
        ctx.fillStyle='rgba(108,114,255,.55)';
        ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(108,114,255,.16)';
        for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){
          var p=pts[i];
          if(!reduce){p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0||p.x>w)p.vx*=-1;if(p.y<0||p.y>h)p.vy*=-1;}
          ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,1.3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
          for(var j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){
            var q=pts[j], dx=p.x-q.x, dy=p.y-q.y, d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
            if(d<120){ctx.globalAlpha=1-d/120;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x,p.y);ctx.lineTo(q.x,q.y);ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
          }
        }
        if(!reduce)raf=requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }
      resize(); draw();
      window.addEventListener('resize',function(){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);resize();draw();},{passive:true});
    })();

    function animateReadiness(){
      var ring=document.getElementById('drring');
      var val=document.getElementById('drval');
      document.querySelectorAll('#drwrap .dc-drm-bar').forEach(function(b){b.style.width=(b.getAttribute('data-v')||0)+'%';});
      if(ring){ring.style.strokeDashoffset=String(364*(1-0.74));}
      if(val){
        var n=0, target=74;
        var t=setInterval(function(){n+=2; if(n>=target){n=target;clearInterval(t);} val.textContent=n+'%';},30);
      }
    }

    var overview=document.getElementById('hero-overview-wrap');
    if(overview&&!document.getElementById('hero-overview-video')){
      var wrap=document.createElement('div');

      setWidth();paint(false);

    function activateStage(idx){

      if(stageTourIdleTimer){clearTimeout(stageTourIdleTimer);stageTourIdleTimer=null;}

    function scheduleStageTour(){
      if(stageTourPaused||stageTourTimer||stageTourIdleTimer)return;
